name: Craiyon
summary: Craiyon (formerly DALL·E mini) is a free AI image generator that creates fun, surreal images from any text prompt. It is popular for social sharing and creative experimentation.
description: Craiyon (formerly DALL·E mini) is a free AI image generator that creates fun, surreal images from any text prompt. It is popular for social sharing and creative experimentation. Free Text-to-Image: No signup or payment required. Unlimited Generation: Create as many images as you want. Fun Styles: Surreal, cartoonish outputs. Community Gallery: Share and browse creations.

pricing.label: Free

features: Free Text-to-Image: No signup or payment required.
Unlimited Generation: Create as many images as you want.
Community Gallery: Share and browse creations.

howToUse.title: Go to Craiyon
howToUse.description: Access Craiyon from any browser or device. No sign-up required.

howToUse.title: Enter a Prompt
howToUse.description: Type your desired prompt in the input box.

howToUse.title: Generate Images
howToUse.description: Click 'Draw' to create images. Wait for the AI to finish generating.

howToUse.title: Download or Share
howToUse.description: Download images or share them to the community gallery.

features_fr: Text-to-Image gratuit : aucune inscription ni paiement requis.
Génération illimitée : créez autant d'images que tu le souhaitez.
Styles amusants : sorties surréalistes et caricaturales.
Galerie communautaire : partagez et parcourez les créations.
